summary: Registered the next judgment-changing question and requested its experiment: whether a peer that re-delivers the same peer-form MsgForgetLeader once per heartbeat round keeps a healthy leader's follower from enforcing its lease, so the identical up-to-date candidate's pre-vote is granted every round instead of within a single heartbeat interval. New child question @forged_forget_persistence plus a fresh fixed experiment (fourth test function in the same harness, its own p_ stream): the control round without the forgery, three rounds each delivering the leader's real heartbeat, the same forged message and the same retried pre-vote, and a comparison that checks the repair path still restores lead=1 each round so a repeated failure would be attributed to the sender's cadence rather than a broken repair. The harness runs natively with the predicted events (round 0 no grant; rounds 1-3 restore, lose, and grant while the leader stays StateLeader at term 2), and validation passed with the execution requested. Incomplete: the receipt and its interpretation are pending, so the persistence claim is not yet part of the current account.
